42019-motor-boat-boys-river-chase-or-six.creator: M. A. Donohue & Co.
42019-motor-boat-boys-river-chase-or-six.description: A book by M. A. Donohue & Co.. “Why, Jack sent him back to the post office to see if there was any mail. He’s thinking of George here, who’s expecting a letter from that sweet little Southern girl he met last fall, when we were knocking around the Florida Keys in our motor boats, after coming down the coast.”

arxiv-2003-13487.title: Accretion rate in AGN and X-ray-to-optical flux ratio at z ≤ \leq 0.2 Volume: 356 Journal: Nuclear Activity in Galaxies Across Cosmic Time
arxiv-2003-13487.creator: Asrate Gaulle 1,2, Mirjana Pović 2,3, and Dejene Zewdie 4,5
arxiv-2003-13487.description: Abstract We explored a sample of 545 local galaxies using data from the 3XMM-DR7 and SDSS-DR8 surveys. We carried out all analyses up to z ∼ \sim 0.2, and we studied the relation between X/O flux ratio and accretion rate for different classes of active galaxies such as LINERs and Seyfert 2.

arxiv-2103-09698.title: On the orthogonality of generalized eigenspaces for the Ornstein–Uhlenbeck operator Thanks: The first and second authors are members of the Gruppo Nazionale per l’Analisi Matematica, la Probabilità e le loro Applicazioni (GNAMPA) of the Istituto Nazionale di Alta Matematica (INdAM) and were partiall
arxiv-2103-09698.creator: Valentina Casarino, Paolo Ciatti, Peter Sjögren
arxiv-2103-09698.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Valentina Casarino, Paolo Ciatti, Peter Sjögren. We study the orthogonality of the generalized eigenspaces of an Ornstein–Uhlenbeck operator ℒ \mathscr{L} in ℝ N \mathbb{R}^{N} , with drift given by a real matrix B B whose eigenvalues have negative real parts. If B B has only one eigenvalue, we prove that any two distinct generalized eigenspaces of ℒ \mathscr{L} are orthogonal with respect to the invariant Gaussian measure.

arxiv-2109-04181.title: Independence complex of the lexicographic product of a forest
arxiv-2109-04181.creator: Kengo Okura
arxiv-2109-04181.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Kengo Okura. We study the independence complex of the lexicographic product G ⁡ [ H ] {G}[{H}] of a forest G G and a graph H H . We prove that for a forest G G which is not dominated by a single vertex, if the independence complex of H H is homotopy equivalent to a wedge sum of spheres, then so is the independence complex of G ⁡ [ H ] {G}[{H}] . We offer two examples of explicit calculations.

arxiv-2109-13620.title: Cross-lingual Intermediate Fine-tuning improves Dialogue State Tracking
arxiv-2109-13620.creator: Nikita Moghe, Mark Steedman, Alexandra Birch
arxiv-2109-13620.description: Abstract Recent progress in task-oriented neural dialogue systems is largely focused on a handful of languages, as annotation of training data is tedious and expensive. Machine translation has been used to make systems multilingual, but this can introduce a pipeline of errors. Another promising solution is using cross-lingual transfer learning through pretrained multilingual models.

arxiv-2202-09047.title: Probing Inner-Edge of Dead Zones in Protoplanetary Disks with ALMA and Next Generation Very Large Array Journal: ApJ RADMC-3D ( Dullemond et al. 2012 )
arxiv-2202-09047.creator: Takahiro Ueda, Luca Ricci, Mario Flock, Zachary Castro
arxiv-2202-09047.description: Abstract The discovery of substructures in protoplanetary disks with ALMA has provided us key insights on the formation of planets. However, observational constraints on the formation of rocky planets have been still sparse, especially because of the limited spatial resolution. The inner edge of so-called dead zone is one of the preferential sites of rocky planet formation.

arxiv-2206-14290.title: Equidistribution of zeros of Random polynomials and Random Polynomial mappings on ℂ m \mathbb{C}^{m}
arxiv-2206-14290.creator: Ozan Günyüz
arxiv-2206-14290.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ozan Günyüz. We study equidistribution problem of zeros in relation to a sequence of Z Z -asymptotically Chebyshev polynomials on ℂ m \mathbb{C}^{m} . We use certain results obtained in a very recent work of Bayraktar, Bloom and Levenberg and have an equidistribution result in a more general probabilistic setting than what the paper of Bayraktar, Bloom and Levenberg considers even though the basis polynomials they use are more general than Z Z -asymptotically Chebyshev polynomials.

arxiv-2207-00580.title: Radiation-Reaction in the Effective Field Theory Approach to Post-Minkowskian Dynamics Preprint: DESY 22-109
arxiv-2207-00580.creator: Gregor Kälin,, Jakob Neef,, and Rafael A. Porto
arxiv-2207-00580.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Gregor Kälin,, Jakob Neef,, and Rafael A. Porto. We extend the Post-Minkowskian (PM) effective field theory (EFT) approach to incorporate conservative and dissipative radiation-reaction effects in a unified framework. This is achieved by implementing the Schwinger-Keldysh “in-in” formalism and separating conservative and non-conservative terms according to the formulation in chadprl , which we show promotes Feynman’s i ​ 0 i0 -prescription and cutting rules to a prominent role at the classical level.

arxiv-2301-12005.title: EmbedDistill: A Geometric Knowledge Distillation for Information Retrieval
arxiv-2301-12005.creator: Seungyeon Kim, Ankit Singh Rawat, Manzil Zaheer, Sadeep Jayasumana, Veeranjaneyulu Sadhanala, Wittawat Jitkrittum, Aditya Krishna Menon, Rob Fergus, Sanjiv Kumar
arxiv-2301-12005.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Seungyeon Kim, Ankit Singh Rawat, Manzil Zaheer, Sadeep Jayasumana, Veeranjaneyulu Sadhanala, Wittawat Jitkrittum, Aditya Krishna Menon, Rob Fergus, Sanjiv Kumar. Large neural models (such as Transformers) achieve state-of-the-art performance for information retrieval (IR). In this paper, we aim to improve distillation methods that pave the way for the resource-efficient deployment of such models in practice.

arxiv-2309-16988.title: A slime mold inspired local adaptive mechanism for flow networks
arxiv-2309-16988.creator: Vidyesh Rao Anisetti, 1 , Ananth Kandala, 2 J. M. Schwarz 1,3
arxiv-2309-16988.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Vidyesh Rao Anisetti, 1 , Ananth Kandala, 2 J. M. Schwarz 1,3. In the realm of biological flow networks, the ability to dynamically adjust to varying demands is paramount. Drawing inspiration from the remarkable adaptability of Physarum polycephalum, we present a novel physical mechanism tailored to optimize flow networks. Central to our approach is the principle that each network component—specifically, the tubes— harnesses locally available information to collectively minimize a global cost function.

arxiv-2404-07579.title: Revisiting Data Recovery Loops in 6G Networks
arxiv-2404-07579.creator: Uyoata E. Uyoata 1 3 Abolfazl Amiri 2 4 , Enric Juan 2 , Guillermo Pocovi 2, Pilar Andres-Maldonado 2 , Klaus I. Pedersen 1 2 , and Troels Kolding 2
arxiv-2404-07579.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Uyoata E. Uyoata 1 3 Abolfazl Amiri 2 4 , Enric Juan 2 , Guillermo Pocovi 2, Pilar Andres-Maldonado 2 , Klaus I. Pedersen 1 2 , and Troels Kolding 2. Mechanisms for data recovery and packet reliability are essential components of the upcoming 6 th {}^{\text{th}} generation (6G) communication system.

arxiv-2409-16958.title: Metaheuristic Method for Solving Systems of Equations
arxiv-2409-16958.creator: Samson Odan
arxiv-2409-16958.description: Abstract This study investigates the effectiveness of Genetic Algorithms (GAs) in solving both linear and nonlinear systems of equations, comparing their performance to traditional methods such as Gaussian Elimination, Newton’s Method, and Levenberg-Marquardt. The GA consistently delivered accurate solutions across various test cases, demonstrating its robustness and flexibility.

arxiv-2501-12223.title: The Structure of the Molecular Envelope of the Ring Nebula (NGC 6720)
arxiv-2501-12223.creator: Joel H. Kastner, David J. Wilner, Diana Ryder, Paula Moraga Baez, Orsola De Marco, Raghvendra Sahai, Al Wootten, Albert Zijlstra
arxiv-2501-12223.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Joel H. Kastner, David J. Wilner, Diana Ryder, Paula Moraga Baez, Orsola De Marco, Raghvendra Sahai, Al Wootten, Albert Zijlstra. We present the first interferometric imaging of molecular line emission from the Ring Nebula, NGC 6720, in the form of Submillimeter Array (SMA) observations of CO J = 2 → 1 J=2\rightarrow 1 emission.

arxiv-2503-04495.title: Electroproduction of medium- and heavy-mass hypernuclei
arxiv-2503-04495.creator: P. Bydžovský 1 , D. Denisova 1 , F. Knapp 2 , and P. Veselý 1
arxiv-2503-04495.description: Abstract The DWIA formalism for computing the cross sections in electroproduction of hypernuclei used before for lighter ( p p -shell and s ​ d sd -shell) systems is utilized in studying electroproduction on heavier targets such as 52 Cr, and 208 Pb.

arxiv-2503-19552.title: Cylindrical Euler – Poisson Equation in a Chaplygin Gas Medium
arxiv-2503-19552.creator: Balázs E. Szigeti, 1,2, Imre F. Barna, 2,3, Gergely G. Barnaföldi 1
arxiv-2503-19552.description: Abstract We studied the Euler – Poisson equation system in the case of cylindrical symmetry with the von Neumann – Sedov – Taylor type of self-similar ansatz and present scaling solutions. We have analyzed the scenario governed by Chaplygin’s equation of state, which has historically been studied as a unifying framework of dark fluid for dark matter and dark energy.

arxiv-2507-16838.title: Segmentation-free Goodness of Pronunciation
arxiv-2507-16838.creator: Xinwei Cao, Zijian Fan, Torbjørn Svendsen, Giampiero Salvi
arxiv-2507-16838.description: Abstract Mispronunciation detection and diagnosis (MDD) is a significant part in modern computer aided language learning (CALL) systems. Within MDD, phoneme-level pronunciation assessment is key to helping L2 learners improve their pronunciation. However, most systems are based on a form of goodness of pronunciation (GOP) which requires pre-segmentation of speech into phonetic units.

arxiv-2512-06860.title: Revisiting the Acousto-Electric Effect
arxiv-2512-06860.creator: E. M. Wright, J. Mack, A. Wendt, A. Burrington, W. Roberts, D. Anderson, and M. Eichefield
arxiv-2512-06860.description: Abstract The goal of this paper is to provide a new perspective on the acousto-electric effect by deriving a wave equation for the acoustic field that is akin to Stokes 1845 viscous wave equation and in which the phonon-electron interaction provides the loss/gain term.

britannica-1911-forskal-peter.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-forskal-peter.description: Article 'Forskål, Peter' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 10), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Adelaide, along the southern shores. In 1874, with his brother Alexander Forrest (born 1849), he explored eastwards from Champion Bay, following as far as possible the 26th parallel, and striking the telegraph line between Adelaide and Port Darwin; a distance of about 2000 m. was covered in about five months with horses and without carriers, a particularly fine achievement (see Australia: Exploration).

plos-pone-0004325.title: Rhythmicity in Mice Selected for Extremes in Stress Reactivity: Behavioural, Endocrine and Sleep Changes Resembling Endophenotypes of Major Depression
plos-pone-0004325.creator: Chadi Touma, Thomas Fenzl, Jörg Ruschel et al.
plos-pone-0004325.description: PLOS ONE research article. Dysregulation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis, including hyper- or hypo-activity of the stress hormone system, plays a critical role in the pathophysiology of mood disorders such as major depression (MD). Further biological hallmarks of MD are disturbances in cir

pmc-10564153.title: The LEAP checklist for laboratory evaluation and analytical performance characteristics reporting of clinical measurement procedures
pmc-10564153.creator: Tze Ping Loh, Brian R Cooke, Thi Chi Mai Tran, Corey Markus, Rosita Zakaria, Chung Shun Ho, Elvar Theodorsson, Ronda F Greaves
pmc-10564153.description: Reporting a measurement procedure and its analytical performance following method evaluation in a peer-reviewed journal is an important means for clinical laboratory practitioners to share their findings. It also represents an important source of evidence base to help others make informed decisions about their practice.

pmc-11385155.title: Lipid metabolism reprogramming in endometrial cancer: biological functions and therapeutic implications
pmc-11385155.creator: Xiangyu Wang, Yinuo Li, Xin Hou, Jingfang Li, Xiangyi Ma
pmc-11385155.description: BackgroundEndometrial cancer is one of the major gynecological cancers, with increasing incidence and mortality in the past decades. Emerging preclinical and clinical data have indicated its close association with obesity and dyslipidemia. Metabolism reprogramming has been considered as the hallmark of cancer, to satisfy the extensive need of nutrients and energy for survival and growth.

pmc-11484269.title: Concurrent chronic kidney disease in patients with inflammatory bowel disease, a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11484269.creator: Xiaoping Han, Zifeng Xu, Yu Chang, Hongyan Li, Sileng Hu, Shiyu Chang, Yue Liu, Chanjiao Yu, Tongyu Tang, Yuqin Li
pmc-11484269.description: IntroductionInflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is a multi-organ autoimmune disease that commonly affects the gastrointestinal tract, but can also affect other organs throughout the body. Less is known, however, about kidney involvement in IBD. Although IBD has been associated with chronic kidney disease (CKD) and end-stage renal disease (ESRD), these results have been inconsistent.

pmc-11607459.title: Investigation on multiple traffic noise near an airport and their effect on nearby residents
pmc-11607459.creator: Quanmin Liu, Kui Gao, Lizhong Song, Linya Liu, Yunke Luo
pmc-11607459.description: This study investigates the impact of the noise radiated from airplanes, urban rail transit, high-speed railways, and urban roads on residents near an airport. The results showed that all respondents near the airport were highly annoyed with airplane noise, and some remain annoyed with the noise from the urban rail transit and high-speed railway connecting to the airport.

pmc-11640591.title: Genome Instability and Senescence Are Markers of Cornelia de Lange Syndrome Cells
pmc-11640591.creator: Maddalena Di Nardo, Ian D Krantz, Antonio Musio, Yasumichi Inoue
pmc-11640591.description: Cornelia de Lange syndrome (CdLS) is a rare, dominantly inherited multisystem developmental disorder. Pathogenic variants in genes encoding the structural subunits and regulatory proteins of the cohesin complex (NIPBL, SMC1A, SMC3, HDAC8, and RAD21) are the primary contributors to the pathogenesis of CdLS.

pmc-12506511.title: Arthroscopic suture-bridge repair of small and medium supraspinatus tears: a simplified Lassoloop technique with single medial and knotless lateral anchors
pmc-12506511.creator: Songlin Liu, Liang Ma
pmc-12506511.description: BackgroundThe transition in arthroscopic rotator cuff repair from single-row to double-row techniques has highlighted the efficacy of the suture-bridge configuration in providing enhanced biomechanical stability and coverage of the footprint. However, traditional methods often require multiple anchors and complex knot-tying procedures, resulting in prolonged surgical duration and increased costs.

pmc-12599164.title: Essential Role of the AfudrnA Gene in Conidiation and Early Asexual Development in Aspergillus fumigatus
pmc-12599164.creator: Mohammed A Abdo-Elgabbar, Sang-Cheol Jun, Yu-Kyung Kim, Saeed Alasmari, Bashir Salim, Kap-Hoon Han
pmc-12599164.description: Helix-loop-helix (HLH) transcription factors are essential regulators of various cellular processes, including growth, differentiation, and development. In Aspergillus fumigatus, a major fungal pathogen, the HLH transcription factor encoded by the AfudrnA gene plays a critical role in the organism’s asexual reproductive cycle. This study provides a comprehensive analysis of AfudrnA and its function in conidiation, a key asexual reproductive process.

pmc-12624082.title: Seizure onset zone (SoZ) identification from interictal intracranial electroencephalogram
pmc-12624082.creator: Sai Sanjay Balaji, Keshab K Parhi
pmc-12624082.description: Accurate localization of the seizure onset zone (SoZ) is critical for effective surgical treatment in drug-resistant epilepsy. Traditional SoZ biomarkers, such as interictal epileptiform discharges (IEDs), high-frequency oscillation (HFO) rate, and relative band power (RBP), often fail to capture the complex network dynamics underlying seizure generation fully.

pmc-12973308.title: ED90 of Remimazolam for Moderate Sedation in Children Undergoing Neurosurgery
pmc-12973308.creator: Fei-Yu Tao, Yan-Jie Yang, Lu-Chao Gao, Yu Li, Yi-Wei Li, Dong-Liang Mu, Xin-Lin Hou, Dong-Xin Wang
pmc-12973308.description: BackgroundPreoperative sedation is critical to alleviate anxiety in children undergoing neurosurgery, but the role of remimazolam is still uncertain such as its unestablished dosing and safety. This study was aimed to determine the 90% effective dose (ED90) of remimazolam for moderate sedation in this pediatric population.MethodsThis dose-finding study enrolled children aged 3 months to 6 years scheduled for neurosurgery.

pmc-13194467.title: Case Report: Neuroendocrine-marker–negative high-grade neuroendocrine carcinoma mimicking squamous cell carcinoma: an underrecognized diagnostic pitfall
pmc-13194467.creator: Wen He, Ying Tang, Yan Li, Jianfeng Zhang, Xuyang You, Qiaozhen Wu
pmc-13194467.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). High-grade neuroendocrine carcinoma (NEC) can be difficult to diagnose, particularly when conventional neuroendocrine (NE) markers are weakly expressed or absent. This challenge is particularly pronounced in NE-low tumors with lineage-defining transcription factor profiles (e.g., POU2F3 and/or YAP1), which may exhibit squamoid (basal-like) morphology and reduced or absent expression of synaptophysin (Syn), chromogranin A (CgA), and CD56, thereby phenotypically overlapping with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and increasing the risk of misclassification.

pmc-13268036.title: 17. Global Gaps In Gender-affirming Surgery Education: Insights From 1,000+ Medical Students Across 11 Countries
pmc-13268036.creator: Meera Shankar
pmc-13268036.description: nternational scale. This study aimed to evaluate medical students’ exposure to and perceptions of GAS education, identify barriers and motivators to learning, and characterize preferred educational modalities. Methods: A cross-sectional, anonymous survey was distributed electronically between January and June 2025 to students in clinical years of training at 38 medical schools across 11 countries.

pmc-13393785.title: Broadening the inherited ASXL3 spectrum and unveiling molecular mechanisms through detailed genotypic-phenotypic analyses
pmc-13393785.creator: Emily Woods, Nicola Holmes, Catherine Gooch, Anne-Sophie Denommé-Pichon, Antonio Vitobello, Marie Vincent, Efterpi Pavlidou, Athina Ververi, Virginie J.M. Verhoeven, Marjon A. van Slegtenhorst, Abhijit Dixit, Ajoy Sarkar, Meena Balasubramanian
pmc-13393785.description: PurposeASXL3-related disorder is a highly heterogeneous neurodevelopmental disorder, with increasing reports of inherited and recurrent variants indicating substantial intrafamilial phenotypic variability, as well as the possibility of interfamilial phenotypic variability.MethodsIn this study, we conducted a detailed genotype-phenotype review of 204 individuals from the literature, including the International ASXL3 Natural History Study (IRAS: 316055).

pmc-13684603.title: Structure of an RNA polymerase ribozyme replication complex
pmc-13684603.creator: Timothy S. Strutzenberg, David P. Horning, Wesley G. Cochrane, Leonardo Andrade, Xuan Han, Gerald F. Joyce, Dmitry Lyumkis
pmc-13684603.description: Life began with the emergence of a molecule that could replicate its own genetic material, a task plausibly mediated by an RNA-dependent RNA polymerase ribozyme. Here, we present the structure of such a polymerase ribozyme, bound to RNA substrates comprising the template, primer, and nucleoside triphosphate (NTP) analog.
